# Model screen (generated by `experiments/model_screen.py`)

291,580 reviews from 1,193 training hotels; 3-fold GroupKFold by hotel (training hotels only). TF-IDF (and the SVD for tree models) fitted inside each fold. p-values: corrected resampled t-test against the best model, Holm-adjusted (three folds, so low power).

| Model | PR-AUC (mean ± SD) | ROC-AUC | p vs best (Holm) | Fit time, s |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Logistic regression (final model) | 0.863 ± 0.003 | 0.974 | 1.000 | 26 |
| Linear SVM | 0.858 ± 0.003 | 0.972 | 0.007 | 16 |
| Passive-aggressive | 0.855 ± 0.003 | 0.970 | 0.012 | 7 |
| SGD (modified Huber loss) | 0.851 ± 0.003 | 0.962 | 0.002 | 3 |
| Ridge classifier | 0.829 ± 0.003 | 0.962 | 0.004 | 12 |
| Multinomial naive Bayes | 0.795 ± 0.007 | 0.965 | 0.012 | 1 |
| Complement naive Bayes | 0.790 ± 0.007 | 0.964 | 0.012 | 0 |
| LSA-200 + histogram gradient boosting | 0.746 ± 0.007 | 0.951 | 0.011 | 314 |
| LSA-200 + logistic regression | 0.708 ± 0.007 | 0.947 | 0.012 | 11 |
| LSA-200 + random forest | 0.636 ± 0.014 | 0.924 | 0.012 | 1043 |
| Bernoulli naive Bayes | 0.532 ± 0.003 | 0.923 | 0.002 | 1 |
| Prior only (no information) | 0.089 ± 0.000 | 0.500 | 0.000 | 0 |
